reference_sql:
SELECT ol.order_line_id, s.product_name AS sister_name, ph.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = s.product_id AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) >= ph.valid_from AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) <= ph.valid_to)
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10'
alternatives: SELECT ol.order_line_id, s.product_name AS sister_name, ph.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.sister_product_id AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN ph.valid_from AND COALESCE(ph.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09'

WITH week_lines AS (SELECT ol.order_line_id, ol.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS order_date FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10') SELECT w.order_line_id, s.product_name AS sister_name, ph.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur FROM week_lines w JOIN products p ON p.product_id = w.product_id JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = s.product_id AND w.order_date >= ph.valid_from AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR w.order_date <= ph.valid_to)

other_way.tradeoff: Collecting the week's lines with their dates in a CTE first keeps each join short, but the query gets longer.

SELECT l.order_line_id, s.product_name AS sister_name, h.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id
JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = s.product_id
  AND h.valid_from <= CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)
  AND (h.valid_to IS NULL OR h.valid_to >= CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE))
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
